title: St. Pierre Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual St. Pierre Cathedral, Geneva: six free-standing Corinthian-like columns/open portico, inset wood portals and triangular pediment/rounded gray metal vault; adjoining tall Gothic Maccabees chapel with pointed glazing, buttresses and steep brown roof. Long brown-roofed nave/aisles, rounded east apse, unequal pale open belfry towers, south hipped cap versus north two-tier arcade/steep roof/pinnacles, and tall green octagonal panelled/ribbed central spire. Five existing shared stone/continuous limestone/flat tile/copper/wood graphs, metric UVs, linear tints and four browser levels. Fine carved heraldry/statues/tracery, exact weather vanes, interiors and surveyed paving remain approximate or excluded.
